name: Buzzers
author: Bench Workshop
description: An active buzzer (beeps by itself when powered) and a passive buzzer (plays the note you give it with tone()). You hear them: the toolbar's Sound button turns part sounds on and off.

parts.name: Active buzzer
parts.description: Beeps (about 2.3 kHz) whenever + is above 2.5 V: digitalWrite(pin, HIGH) to beep, LOW to stop. Long leg + to a pin, short leg - to GND. A tone() on it just sounds rough: it has its own oscillator.

parts.name: Passive buzzer
parts.description: Plays the frequency it's driven at: tone(pin, 440) is an A, noTone(pin) stops. A plain HIGH only clicks. + to a pin, - to GND.

examples.name: Play a tune
examples.description: A board playing a short tune on a passive buzzer with tone(), and beeping an active buzzer between the notes. Press Run (and turn Sound on).
